paragraphs.text: One prompt = one push-up. Vibe code now, pay in push-ups later.
# dsh-pushups
**Typing is not cardio.** It just has better marketing.

`dsh-pushups` is a small DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for the
**Web GUI**: every message you send t

o the assistant becomes **one push-up of debt**. Stand up,
do the set, pay it off — in one go or in

assistant becomes **one push-up of debt**. Stand up,
do the set, pay it off — in one go or in parts.
## Why this exists

You are a mammal running a chat interface. Around hour six of "just one more prompt" your spine
has

quietly become a Jenga tower with a deadline, your legs have filed for remote work, and
"I'll stretc
h in a minute" has been in the backlog since Tuesday.

Here's the trap: talking to a machine *feels* like doing something. The tokens stream, the diff
appe

ars, the dopamine lands — and none of it requires your body. So the body gets the leftovers:
the sti
ff neck, the 4 PM fog, the vague memory of having shoulders.

The usual remedies all lost to a notification that says "later". Later is not a time. Later is
where
good intentions go to be archived.

So the deal is stupid on purpose: **one prompt = one push-up.** Not a workout plan, not a
wellness j

ourney — a number under the composer that grows every time you write to an AI instead
of moving your
own body. When it gets annoying enough, you get up. That's the whole mechanism.
It will not fix your posture. It will make it slightly less fictional.
> Physics doesn't read intentions. Gravity is the only reviewer that never leaves "looks good to me"

[代码示例省略，未执行]

Click the chip, and a dialog shows the lifetime message count, the unpaid debt, the streak of
days c

losed without debt, recent payments, partial-payment buttons (`+5`, `+10`, `+25`, all),
a custom amo
unt, and a language switch (English / Русский / 中文 — English by default).

Next to the chip sits a one-click ✓ button: when you have already done the push-ups, it pays
the who
le debt without opening anything. The dialog stays for the details.
## What counts

One admitted human prompt: a session event `user/message` whose source is
`{ kind: 'user', rpcId: <s

tring> }`. This is exactly the signal DSH itself uses for
"a human typed this in the Web GUI".
Not counted:

- retries — `user/message` is appended once per admitted message, never per attempt;
- automatic goa

l continuation rounds (`source.kind === 'goal'`);
- scheduled, webhook, tool-context and other machi

efore the plugin was installed (the counter starts at zero on install);
- prompts sent from other cl
ients (TUI, ACP, SDK) — the `rpcId` discriminator is Web-only.
## Requirements

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` or newer with the `web` profile;
- no build step: the Client half is plain JavaSc

## Data
The ledger is a single JSON file owned by the Host half:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

It holds the install timestamp, the lifetime count, the current debt, the streak, bounded
per-day co

unters (400 days) and the last 500 payments. The Host also serves three loopback
routes for the Clie

nt: `GET /pushups/state`, `POST /pushups/pay`, `POST /pushups/reset`.
They are unauthenticated by de

sign — DSH's web server binds `127.0.0.1` and this data is a
push-up counter, not a secret.
## Agent tool

The Host registers one read-only tool, `pushups_status`, so the assistant can answer
"сколько я долж
ен?" with the live number. It never adds nudges to replies on its own.
## Rules baked in

- 1 message = 1 push-up; no daily cap, no coefficient — a cap is permission to cheat;
- debt carries

breaks the streak; a day closed at zero extends it;
- "Reset everything" requires a second click an

d zeroes lifetime, debt and history;
- nothing blocks sending — blocking would make you write less,

ime, debt and history;
- nothing blocks sending — blocking would make you write less, not move more.
## Limitations

- Web GUI only; the counter is global across all sessions and projects of this installation.
- Day b

oundaries follow the Host machine's local time zone.
- The streak advances when the Host observes a

day rollover (on any message, payment or state
read), so it is an honest approximation, not a cron j

ob.
- No data migration: the state file carries a version and a mismatched version starts fresh.
